fusions.name: Comb Through
fusions.desc: Drags a comb of strands across the target at a cost of 4% of your maximum health, dealing 9 slashing damage and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Windrow
fusions.desc: Sweeps a strand across the ground into the first enemy it meets, dealing 28 damage. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Gather In
fusions.desc: Drags up to 5 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Gleanings
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 6 stamina and 3 health. Once every 3 seconds.
